Familiar uses the camera to add a photo draft to your message.
Familiar scans only for the Bluetooth service UUIDs you explicitly request and never connects automatically.
Familiar reads calendar events you ask about and adds an event only after you confirm its preview.
Familiar searches contacts only when you ask and only after you approve access.
Familiar reads only the health activity summaries you explicitly request and never writes health data.
Familiar requests a single foreground location only when your task needs it.
Familiar saves a Workspace image to Photos only after you approve the exact output.
Familiar reads recent photo metadata only when you ask, respects limited access, and does not read image pixels without a separate selection.
Familiar searches the Apple Music catalog only when you ask and never plays or changes your library automatically.
Familiar schedules an alarm only after you confirm its exact time, and you can cancel it at any time.
Familiar reads reminders you ask about and adds a reminder only after you confirm its preview.
Familiar uses the microphone only while transcribing your voice into an editable message draft.
Familiar uses Apple Speech to turn your voice into editable text and does not keep an audio recording.
